nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the friend's empty front porch: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the grandmother's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 is the friend's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, round glasses, church hat and clothes. Medium shot. The photo shows the two women seated side by side on the white porch swing, the empty baking dish on the grandmother's lap, a coffee mug on the side table. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm undertones, a round face, short tapered silver-white coily hair, gold-framed reading glasses hanging on a chain at her chest, small gold earrings and a small gold cross. She wears a lavender cardigan over a plain white T-shirt and grey slacks. The friend: a 73-year-old Black American woman with deep brown skin, a long oval face, short close-cropped silver natural hair and large round tortoiseshell glasses worn on her face; tall and slender. She is just back from church and keeps her church hat on all afternoon: a moss-green church hat with a medium upturned brim, a matching band and a small fabric flower, worn tilted slightly to one side, her silver hair showing below it; a moss-green dress, a matching cardigan with a small brooch, a canvas tote bag on her shoulder. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: soft late-afternoon sun, warm and calm. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: the grandmother is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain and gold jewelry; the friend is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, round glasses and moss-green church hat; nobody else wears a hat. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
